title: Choose a different geometry
summary: Geometry describes an object's shape. A sphere geometry uses small triangles to approximate a round surface.
introduction: Geometry describes an object's shape. A sphere geometry uses small triangles to approximate a round surface. Your task: Change the sphere radius from 0.7 to 1.

blocks.text: Geometry describes an object's shape. A sphere geometry uses small triangles to approximate a round surface.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Choose a different geometry

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `SphereGeometry` takes a radius and segment counts. More segments make a smoother but more detailed mesh.
A perspective camera needs a field of view, aspect ratio, near distance and far distance to describe its view.
`MeshBasicMaterial` gives a visible surface without requiring lights. It is useful for a first shape example.

blocks.text: A blue ball is drawn instead of the cube.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: More segments make a smoother shape but require more work. Use enough detail for the displayed size.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the sphere radius from 0.7 to 1.
